Links.Author: JEEJON

Notes: In many ways this pen is the spiritual successor to the Pro Pen 2. It has a similar shape, it has a similar cost, almost the same pressure performance, and a more conventional body design than the Pro Pen 3. I love this pen, but its big limitation is the small number of tablets it works with.
